L11@P0: Notice of the 59th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders
L12@P0: This is to notify you of the 59th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders of OBIC Co., Ltd. (the “Company”), which
L13@P0: will be held as indicated below.
L14@P0: When convening the Meeting, the Company takes measures for providing information that constitutes the content of
L15@P0: reference documents for the general meeting of shareholders, etc. (matters for which measures for providing
L16@P0: information in electronic format are to be taken) in electronic format, and posts this information on relevant websites.
L17@P0: Please access either of these websites by using the Internet address shown below to review the information.
L18@P0: The Company’s website:
L19@P0: https://www.obic.co.jp/ir/stock.html/ (in Japanese)
L20@P0: Website for posted informational materials for the general meeting of shareholders:
L21@P0: https://d.sokai.jp/4684/teiji/ (in Japanese)
L22@P0: TSE website (Listed Company Search):
L23@P0: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/tseHpFront/JJK010010Action.do?Show=Show (in Japanese)
L24@P0: (Access the TSE website by using the internet address shown above, enter “OBIC” in “Issue name (company name)”
L25@P0: or the Company’s securities code “4684” in “Code,” and click “Search.” Then, click “Basic information” and select
L26@P0: “Documents for public inspection/PR information.” Under “Filed information available for public inspection,” click
L27@P0: “Click here for access” under “[Notice of General Shareholders Meeting /Informational Materials for a General
L28@P0: Shareholders Meeting].”)
L29@P0: If you are unable to attend the meeting in person, you may exercise your voting rights in writing or via the Internet.
L30@P0: Please review the attached Reference Documents for General Meeting of Shareholders, and indicate your approval
L31@P0: or disapproval of the proposals in the enclosed voting card, and then return the card to the Company by postal mail
L32@P0: so that your vote is received by 5:30 p.m. on Wednesday, June 24, 2026 (JST) or access the website for the exercise
L33@P0: of voting rights (https://evote.tr.mufg.jp/ (in Japanese)) designated by the Company and exercise your voting rights.

L45@P1: Proposal No. 1 Appropriation of Surplus
L46@P1: Proposal No. 2 Election of Nine (9) Directors

L48@P1: (1) If you exercise your voting rights in writing and do not indicate your approval or disapproval of a proposal,
L49@P1: we will assume that you have indicated your approval of the proposal.
L50@P1: (2) If you exercise your voting rights more than once via the Internet, the last exercise shall be deemed to be
L51@P1: valid.
L52@P1: (3) If you exercise your voting rights both in writing and via the Internet, only the vote placed via the Internet
L53@P1: will be treated as valid.
L54@P1: (4) If you exercise your voting rights by proxy, another shareholder with voting rights in the Company may
L55@P1: attend as your proxy. Please note, however, that it is necessary to submit a document evidencing the authority
L56@P1: of proxy.

L72@P2: Reference Documents for General Meeting of Shareholders
L73@P2: Proposal No. 1 Appropriation of Surplus
L74@P2: The Company recognizes the return of profit to its shareholders as one of its key management priorities. In addition
L75@P2: to ensuring a solid management base and improving return on equity, the Company aims to meet its shareholders’
L76@P2: expectations by both further enhancing the financial position and re-investing.
L77@P2: Regarding the appropriation of surplus for the current fiscal year, the Company has given consideration to the
L78@P2: business performance of the current fiscal year and future business development and proposes the payment of yearend dividends and other appropriation of surplus as follows:
L79@P2: 1. Year-end dividends
L80@P2: (1) Type of dividend property
L81@P2: To be paid in cash.
L82@P2: (2) Allotment of dividend property and their aggregate amount
L83@P2: The Company proposes to pay a dividend of ¥47 per common share of the Company.
L84@P2: In this event, the total dividends will be ¥20,366,669,330.
L85@P2: (3) Effective date of dividends of surplus
L86@P2: The effective date of dividends shall be June 26, 2026.
L87@P2: 2. Other matters concerning appropriation of surplus
L88@P2: (1) Item of surplus to be decreased and amount of decrease
L89@P2: Retained earnings brought forward: ¥10,000,000,000
L90@P2: (2) Item of surplus to be increased and amount of increase
L91@P2-3: General reserve: ¥10,000,000,000 - 4 -
